context: Sho-young watches his first ever movie at a cinema with Mei.
purpose: Mother taking child to first big movie experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、本場の映画館、すごい!
lines.en: Mom, look—a real cinema! This is amazing!
lines.style: Bright, open-mouthed wonder on "amazing." Quick energy, each phrase lifting slightly. Small voice but absolutely present. The awe of a child who's stepped into something bigger than he expected.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 映像、ようけ綺麗、感じるね。
lines.en: The pictures are so beautiful. You can really feel it.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Warm smile underneath. Slight pause before "feel"—noticing her son noticing. Fingers steady, breathing easy. The moment a parent realizes their child is having a real experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 恐竜、出てきた、ようけ熱い場面!
lines.en: The dinosaur came out—there was such an exciting part!
lines.style: Rapid, tumbling excitement. Voice climbing on "exciting." Bounces slightly in his seat. Can barely contain the scene in his words. Breathless at the peak, then catches himself to keep talking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 冒険、深く感じる物語ね。
lines.en: It's such an adventure, isn't it? You can feel how deep the story goes.
lines.style: Quieter register. Thoughtful pace, letting each word settle. Speaking partly to Sho, partly to herself. A gentle, almost reverent tone—noticing something true about the film, about the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 主人公、勇気、ようけある!
lines.en: The main character has so much courage!
lines.style: Direct admiration, no performance. Voice steady and clear. Child's certainty—he knows what he saw. Slight emphasis on "courage" without forcing it. Simple, sincere appreciation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 楽しい時間ね、お母さんも嬉しい。
lines.en: This was such a fun time together. I'm happy too, you know.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Small laugh underneath. Direct eye contact in her voice. Not explaining her happiness, just sharing it. The ease of someone completely present with her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Not performing thankfulness—actually meaning it. Voice smaller here, more intimate. A child's honest heart. Slight trailing warmth on the final word.
